data.name: Ui_ViewRange_Type1_Description
data.value: Simple sum of the LoS values of ships and equipment

data.name: Ui_ViewRange_Type2_Description
data.value: (Recon Aircraft × 2) + (Radar) + √(total fleet LoS including equipment - recon aircraft - radar)

data.name: Ui_ViewRange_Type3_Description
data.value: (Carrier-based Dive Bombers × 1.04) + (Carrier-based Torpedo Bombers × 1.37) + (Carrier-based Reconnaissance Aircraft × 1.66) + (Seaplane Reconnaissance Aircraft × 2.00) + (Seaplane Bombers × 1.78) + (Searchlights × 0.91) + (Small Radars × 1.00) + (Large Radars × 0.99) + (√base LoS of each ship × 1.69) + (Admiral level rounded up to the next multiple of 5 × -0.61)

data.name: Ui_ViewRange_Type4_Description
data.value: Sum of ((equipment LoS in each slot + improvement bonus) × equipment type coefficient) + sum of (√base LoS of each ship) - ceiling(Admiral level × 0.4) + number of empty fleet slots × 2 * Evacuated ships are excluded when counting empty slots
